| Parameter | Default | Values | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|
| **Output** `output` | Table for the whole image | Table for the whole image, Map of one property | All properties for the whole image as a table, or one property in a sliding window as an image. |
| **Gray levels** `levels` | 8 | 2 to 16 | The luma is quantized to this many levels, so the matrix has levels x levels entries. |
| **Distance** `distance` | 1 | 1 to 20 px | How far apart the two pixels of a pair are. The table also lists distance 1. |
| **Angle** `angle` | 0 degrees (right) | 0 degrees (right), 45 degrees (up right), 90 degrees (up), 135 degrees (up left) | The direction from the first pixel of a pair to the second, counterclockwise from the right. Used by the map. The table lists all four. |
| **Symmetric** `symmetric` | on | On or off | Count each pair both ways, so the matrix is symmetric and opposite directions give the same values. |
| **Map property** `property` | Contrast | Contrast, Dissimilarity, Homogeneity, Angular second moment, Energy, Correlation, Entropy | The property the map shows. |
| **Window** `window` | 15 | 3 to 63, odd px | The side of the square window of the map. |
